source: Realignment of the original "SOC 2" 1.0.0 requirements to the official criteria in soc2-tsc-2017-core.json. A record keeps its id when its former text describes an official criterion (renumbered where formerLabel differs), because RequirementMap rows reference these ids. Retired records had no criterion of their own; references to them move to replacedBy.

criteria.formerText: Commitment to integrity & ethical values
Board independence & oversight of internal control
Organizational structure, authority, and responsibility
Commitment to attract, develop, and retain competent people
Accountability for internal-control responsibilities
Use relevant, quality information
Internal communication of objectives & responsibilities
External communication with customers, regulators, vendors
Specify objectives (operations, reporting, compliance)
Identify & analyze risks to achieving those objectives
Consider potential for fraud
Identify & assess risks arising from change
Conduct ongoing and/or separate evaluations
Evaluate, communicate, and remediate deficiencies
Select & develop control activities to mitigate risk
Select & develop general controls over technology (ITGCs)
Deploy controls through policies, procedures, automation
Authentication mechanisms enforce strong credentials and MFA.
criteria.rationale: Authentication mechanisms and MFA are logical access security over protected information assets (CC6.1).

criteria.formerText: Provisioning of logical and physical access is authorized.
criteria.rationale: Authorizing access before it is provisioned is registering and authorizing users before issuing credentials (CC6.2).

criteria.formerText: Logical and physical access is modified or removed when no longer required.
criteria.rationale: Modifying or removing access is CC6.3.

criteria.formerText: Physical access to facilities and equipment is limited and monitored.
criteria.rationale: Restricting physical access to facilities is CC6.4.

criteria.formerText: Network and session controls restrict unauthorized connections.
criteria.rationale: Restricting unauthorized network connections protects against threats from sources outside the system boundaries (CC6.6).

criteria.formerText: Logical assets removed from controlled facilities remain protected.
criteria.rationale: Protecting assets removed from controlled facilities is protecting information during movement or removal (CC6.7).

criteria.formerText: The system is protected against security threats (malware, intrusion, etc.).
criteria.rationale: Protection against malware and intrusion is CC6.8.

criteria.formerText: Vulnerabilities are identified, evaluated, and remediated.
criteria.rationale: Identifying and remediating vulnerabilities is CC7.1.

criteria.formerText: The system is monitored to detect security events and anomalies.
criteria.rationale: Monitoring for security events and anomalies is CC7.2.

criteria.formerText: A documented incident-response process exists and is followed.
criteria.rationale: Following a defined incident-response process is CC7.4.

criteria.formerText: The entity recovers from security incidents and limits their impact.
criteria.rationale: Recovering from security incidents is CC7.5.

criteria.formerText: Changes are authorized, designed, tested, approved, and documented.
Risks from business disruptions are identified and mitigated (BCP/DR).
Commitments with vendors and users regarding the system are fulfilled.
The entity maintains and evaluates current program- and system-availability commitments (e.g., SLAs, uptime targets).
criteria.rationale: Availability commitments (SLAs, uptime targets) are the objectives that A1.1 capacity management and monitoring exist to meet; no other availability criterion covers evaluating them.

criteria.formerText: The entity implements environmental protections (redundant power, HVAC, fire suppression) to support system availability.
The entity tests recovery-plan procedures supporting availability at a frequency commensurate with business requirements.
The entity identifies and maintains confidential information consistent with commitments and requirements.
The entity disposes of confidential information to meet commitments and requirements.
The entity obtains or generates and uses relevant, quality information to support processing integrity.
The entity implements policies and procedures over inputs, processing, and outputs to achieve integrity objectives.
The entity detects and corrects processing errors in a timely manner.
The entity safeguards stored information supporting processing integrity.
The entity provides notice of privacy practices regarding the collection, use, and retention of personal information.
The entity provides choice and consent mechanisms regarding personal information.
The entity collects personal information consistent with objectives.
The entity limits the use, retention, and disposal of personal information to meet objectives.
The entity enforces retention limits for personal information.
criteria.rationale: Enforcing retention limits is retaining personal information consistent with objectives (P4.2).

criteria.formerText: The entity securely destroys or anonymizes personal information at end of retention.
criteria.rationale: Securely destroying personal information is P4.3.

criteria.formerText: The entity provides individuals with access to their personal information for review and correction.
The entity corrects, amends, or deletes personal information in response to requests.
The entity discloses personal information to third parties only for intended purposes.
The entity ensures third parties receiving personal information have the capacity to protect it
criteria.rationale: Ensuring third parties can protect personal information is obtaining privacy commitments from them (P6.4).

criteria.formerText: The entity notifies affected parties and regulators of privacy breaches.
criteria.rationale: Notifying affected parties and regulators of breaches is P6.6.

criteria.formerText: The entity maintains the quality, accuracy, and completeness of personal information.
criteria.rationale: Maintaining the quality and accuracy of personal information is P7.1.

criteria.formerText: The entity has procedures for addressing privacy complaints.

retired.formerText: Communicate intellectual-property & privacy commitments
retired.rationale: Communicating intellectual-property and privacy commitments to outside parties is external communication (CC2.3).

retired.formerText: Manage controls over third-party relationships
retired.rationale: Managing third-party relationships is vendor and business partner risk management (CC9.2).

retired.formerText: Enforce controls over end-user devices
retired.rationale: End-user device controls are endpoint protection against unauthorized or malicious software (CC6.8).

retired.formerText: Unique identifiers are assigned to prevent shared credentials.
retired.rationale: Unique user identifiers are part of identifying and authenticating users under logical access security (CC6.1).

retired.formerText: Privileged access is restricted and logged; break-glass use is controlled.
retired.rationale: Restricting privileged access is least privilege, which CC6.3 names explicitly.

retired.formerText: Emergency changes are controlled and retrospectively reviewed.
retired.rationale: Emergency changes are a point of focus of change management (CC8.1).

retired.formerText: The entity monitors system availability and environmental events and alerts personnel to take corrective action.
retired.rationale: Monitoring availability and alerting personnel is the monitoring part of A1.1.

retired.formerText: The entity protects confidential information during transmission.
retired.rationale: Protecting information during transmission is CC6.7; confidentiality has no transmission criterion.

retired.formerText: The entity securely destroys or anonymizes confidential information when no longer needed.
retired.rationale: Destroying confidential information is its disposal (C1.2).

retired.formerText: The entity protects against unauthorized manipulation of data during processing.
retired.rationale: Protecting data against manipulation during processing is a control over system processing (PI1.3); the official PI1.4 covers output delivery.

retired.formerText: The entity provides additional notice on data recipients and purposes.
retired.rationale: Notice of recipients and purposes is part of the privacy notice (P1.1).

retired.formerText: The entity provides notice of retention periods for personal information.
retired.rationale: Notice of retention periods is part of the privacy notice (P1.1).

retired.formerText: The entity updates privacy notices promptly when practices change.
retired.rationale: P1.1 requires the notice to be updated and communicated when privacy practices change.

retired.formerText: The entity ensures personal information is used only for stated purposes.
retired.rationale: Using personal information only for stated purposes is P4.1.

retired.formerText: The entity verifies requester identity before providing personal information.
retired.rationale: P5.1 grants access to identified and authenticated data subjects, which covers verifying requester identity.

retired.formerText: The entity fulfils data-subject requests within required timeframes and confirms completion.
retired.rationale: Fulfilling data-subject access requests is P5.1.

retired.formerText: The entity monitors compliance with its privacy policies and practices by third parties.
retired.rationale: Monitoring third parties' privacy compliance is assessing their compliance (P6.4).

retired.formerText: The entity documents and updates privacy responsibilities and procedures.
retired.rationale: Documenting responsibilities and procedures is deploying controls through policies and procedures (CC5.3); privacy has no such criterion.

retired.formerText: The entity trains personnel regarding privacy obligations and responsibilities.
retired.rationale: Privacy training communicates responsibilities internally (CC2.2); privacy has no training criterion.

retired.formerText: The entity reviews privacy objectives and related risks regularly.
retired.rationale: Reviewing privacy risks is risk identification and analysis (CC3.2); privacy has no risk-review criterion.

retired.formerText: The entity protects personal information with security safeguards proportional to risk.
retired.rationale: Security safeguards are covered by the common criteria (CC6.1); privacy has no security criterion.
